verdict.rationale: Superhuman Mail is an AI-native email client, so whether user data is used for AI training is a fair question. The evidence pack contains no documentation of a training opt-out, a no-training commitment, or any related data-use control. The community comments about server-side email storage and read tracking do not address model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
